# cat-harness-tools-tools

`discover.ts`, the reader that finds every declared `tools` graph's Tool nodes by asking the declarations (bean `p0za`), and `index.ts`, this layer's own `tools` graph: the Tool nodes whose in-process module is code here (`bpmn-engine`), declared beside that code so the module path is instance-relative (owner, 2026-10-14: "Move the node to tools"). Every other Tool node, the shell-invoked ones included, stays declared in `cat-harness/tools/`. Undeclared until 2026-10-14, so a remote mount (which lays down declared directories only) left it out and the content core's `glossary-extract.ts`, which imports it, had nothing to import; declared now as a named `code` subgraph, which is also what exports it by package name (`scripts/package-exports.ts`, bean `7pvn`).

Part of [C@T Harness Tools](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `cat-harness-tools-tools`, holding `tools`, `code`.
